title: Far Side
text: Sela's far side. No sun here for another four days; the only light is the Lid's rim, faintly violet where the locks draw power. The landers are down at the drop zone. Over the horizon, small and blue, Hearth.

lines.text: On the long-range band: "We can see your landing lights from here. Barely. Go on."
strike force located. the colony is in range. firing at the colony in 25:00.

choices.label: Go
choices.reply: Open the Lid. Reach the core. The colony is counting on the clock.

notes: onStart of the-lantern. The countdown lantern-fires failing = Cycle.
